subject: Remediation progress: keystore, token-replay, observability fixes — ETA & evidence plan
messages:
From: Patrick Bennett <patrick.bennett@zephyrbank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: sec@acme-sec.com
Date: 2026-11-02T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Request: PT findings status and evidence for keystore/token-replay/logging

Irene,

Thanks for taking this on. Our security team flagged three high-priority findings from the penetration test:
- Keystore exposure (privilege isolation concerns)
- Token replay potential on session endpoints
- Insufficient structured audit events for critical auth paths

We need: a short remediation summary for each finding, an ETA for completion, and what evidence you will provide for our SOC 2 auditor (redacted artifacts are fine). Can you also confirm whether the keystore fix will require downtime or a migration window?

We are hoping to close this block by the end of November, but need concrete ETAs.

Patrick
Senior InfoSec, Zephyr Bank
patrick.bennett@zephyrbank.com
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Patrick Bennett <patrick.bennett@zephyrbank.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: PT findings status and evidence for keystore/token-replay/logging

Patrick — thanks for the clear ask. High level update below; I copied owners for the technical detail and the evidence plan.

Summary (owners):
- Keystore exposure (David Kim): rotation + HSM-backed key material; migration plan in place; minimal read-only window for signing service.
- Token replay (Marissa Cole): nonce + token-binding patch deployed to staging; mitigations include strict session-ttl and replay-detection in front proxy.
- Observability / audit events (Hannah Schmitt): schema additions and SIEM forwarding for critical auth events; retention and sample logs for auditor will be prepared.

Next steps:
- David will confirm exact maintenance window and provide the migration runbook.
- Marissa will attach the patch diff and staging test summary.
- Hannah will outline the evidence package (logs, config, and SIEM ingestion proof).

We will attach a remediation tracker and the redacted pen test report for your review. Expect the first evidence bundle by Nov 6 and a full closure ETA by Nov 20 (target). If you need earlier delivery for any specific artefact, let us know which one and we will prioritize.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: remediation_tracker_20261106.xlsx]
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Patrick Bennett <patrick.bennett@zephyrbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T08:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: PT findings status and evidence for keystore/token-replay/logging

Thanks — technical update on keystore remediation and impact:  

What we are changing:
- Generate new key material into HSM-backed key stores (YubiHSM cluster) and introduce a key-rotation pipeline.
- Restrict access via ACLs: only signing service instances will have unwrap permissions.
- Add audit hooks in the keystore service to emit structured events to the observability pipeline.

Migration plan and downtime:
- Blue/green rollout over three stages: generate keys, replicate to HSM cluster, switch signing traffic.
- Expected impact: a rolling 2–3 minute read-only binding window per signing cluster during switch-over (no full service outage). We will schedule during a low-traffic window; target maintenance window: Nov 18 02:00–04:00 UTC (will confirm).

Evidence to provide:
- Migration runbook (with step-by-step commands) — attached.
- HSM configuration dump (redacted) and ACL snapshot.
- Audit events showing key creation and access for a sample run.

Attachment: nonce_fix_patch.diff  (patch + test notes)

-David
Lead Software Engineer, Infra
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Patrick Bennett <patrick.bennett@zephyrbank.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T10:16:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: PT findings status and evidence for keystore/token-replay/logging

Patrick — quick run-through of the token replay mitigation and evidence plan for the SOC 2 auditor.

Tech details (token replay):
- Implemented nonce per session + short-lived session tokens (TTL 5 minutes for sensitive calls).
- Proxy-level replay detector: signature + nonce store with eviction and rate-limit guard.
- Added additional unit/integration tests; staging replay suite ran 1200 tests with zero regressions.

Evidence bundle we will deliver Nov 6:
- Patch diff (nonce_fix_patch.diff) and staging test results (staging_replay_tests.log).
- Example request/response traces showing replay detection and blocked attempts.
- High-level design doc describing token-binding approach (redacted for public).

Notes on logging/audit: Hannah is assembling the exact log samples and SIEM proof. We are retaining 90 days of critical auth events for the auditor sample.

Marissa Cole
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: staging_replay_tests.log]
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Patrick Bennett <patrick.bennett@zephyrbank.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T16:28:00-08:00
Subject: Evidence bundle and weekly cadence request

Patrick — attaching the initial evidence bundle for your review. Contents:
- Redacted pen test report (pt_report_redacted_zephyr_20261020.pdf)
- Remediation tracker (remediation_tracker_20261106.xlsx) with per-finding owner and status columns
- Nonce fix patch and staging test logs (nonce_fix_patch.diff, staging_replay_tests.log)
- Sample audit logs (auth_events_sample.ndjson) with redaction notes

We will:
- Upload the full evidence folder to the Drive link shared above by end of day Nov 6.
- Provide a weekly snapshot (Tuesdays) to show progress against SEC-4217 until closure.

If your auditor needs additional artefacts (e.g., full SIEM ingestion timestamped replay in a controlled run), tell us which data points are required and we will schedule a demo extraction.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pt_report_redacted_zephyr_20261020.pdf]
